worldcombat.skill.flipturn.summary: Ram the target, somersault off it and land on its far side; with a waiting reserve the flip swaps to it, and a wet user glides further. A target too tall or a ceiling overhead stops the flip at the point of impact. The turn style swings back to a waiting partner, the dive style keeps going.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.use.0: Hit and flip to the far side, switching attack lines
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.use.1: Strike and open distance while in water
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.use.2: Kick off a pursuer and hand your ground to a partner
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.description.0: Rams a living target for %1$s physical damage.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.description.1: Dash distance %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, hit radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.description.2: Crosses %1$s blocks past the target, then glides %2$s blocks depending on style (dive presses on, turn swings back to a partner), and shoves the target %3$s blocks onward along the charge; a wet user glides further.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.description.3: The turn style seeks the nearest ally within %1$s blocks as its landing point.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.turn.on: Turn style: cross the target and swing back to the nearest waiting partner; glide ×0.8, ram ×1.12.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.turn.off: Dive style: cross the target and keep diving away; glide ×1.3, ram ×0.9.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recover %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, costs %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.growth.0: From level %1$s the ram rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.growth.1: From level %1$s the ram rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.preference.tu: On (turn): after crossing, swing back to the nearest waiting partner (or back to the near side if there is none); glide ×0.8, ram ×1.12. Off (dive): keep diving away past the target; glide ×1.3, ram ×0.9. One trades a heavier hit and regrouping for a longer escape.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it closes in first; a bit wider than the dash so it still starts the flip, lower keeps it at point-blank.
Below this health ratio, flip turn is ranked first to somersault away; raise it to leave earlier, lower it to keep it for emergencies.
When on, the user flips away even under a hold order; off keeps it only when convenient in place.
worldcombat.skill.flipturn.description.s: If a reserve is available, it is swapped in at the landing point; with no reserve you simply keep the crossed landing.
